components.name: Stamp Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 100%; height: 52px; padding: 0 32px; background: #b84434; color: #e6ecf1; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: normal; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a83c2e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b84434; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #31425a; color: #e6ecf1; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Paper Sheet

components.html:
오늘의 편지

2026년 9월 2일 수요일

이름과 태어난 날을 적으면 오늘 하루의 편지를 엽니다.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #e6ecf1; color: #17233c; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 16%, transparent); border-radius: 0; padding: 56px 24px 40px; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 12%, transparent); font-family: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin: 0 0 40px; padding: 0 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 16%, transparent); } .ds-sheet-name { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #17233c; } .ds-sheet-date { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.54; color: #31425a; text-align: right; } .ds-sheet-body { margin: 0; max-width: 36ch; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; color: #31425a; }

components.name: Clipboard Clip
components.description: Metal tab overlapping the sheet’s top edge. Hardware radius only.
components.css: .ds-clip-stage { position: relative; padding-top: 18px; } .ds-clip { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; z-index: 2; width: 38px; height: 52px; transform: translate(-50%, 0); border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8b97a6 0%, #6d7888 100%); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 22%, transparent); } .ds-clip-rivet { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 9px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 28%, #8b97a6); } .ds-clip-sheet { height: 72px; background: #e6ecf1; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 16%, transparent); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Sheet Header

components.name: Quiet Link

components.name: Letter Skeleton
components.description: Loading as letter-shaped ink washes on the paper. No spinner.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-skeleton-bar { display: block; height: 16px; width: 100%; background: color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 9%, transparent); animation: ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-skeleton-bar--title { height: 32px; width: 80%; background: color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 10%, transparent); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-skeleton-bar--date { width: 8rem; height: 16px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 8%, transparent); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-skeleton-bar--94 { width: 94%; } .ds-skeleton-bar--88 { width: 88%; } .ds-skeleton-bar--advice { width: 60%; margin-top: 16px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #17233c 10%, transparent); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.45; } }

narrative.overview:
The surface is a photocopied morning brief clipped to a metal clip, sitting on a cooler desk. The visitor fills two underline fields on cool gray paper, then reads today's letter on the same sheet. Depth is physical: grain on the desk, one paper plane, one clip. The type is Pretendard only — a Korean morning face, not a night-sky serif.

Personality is quiet, cool, and clerical. Density is a single sheet, not a dashboard. The only warm mark is a sunrise-coral stamp for the primary action; navy ink does the rest. Confirmed visual rejections: night-sky zodiac templates, cream-and-serif defaults, purple glow, and star-wheel chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray paper on a cooler blue-gray desk, sheet offset left on large screens
Navy ink hairlines; one coral stamp (plus coral for focus and error)
Pretendard Variable only; semibold headlines, regular body
Sharp sheet and stamp; underline fields, not boxes
Form and letter share one clipboard frame; width is the only layout change

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only chromatic accent. It marks the stamp, focus, error, and a dawn wash on the desk. It does not color headlines, letter body, or sheet chrome.

rules.name: The Cool Paper Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds stay in the desk–paper pair. Do not introduce cream, white, or night-sky fills.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Pretendard Variable is the only type family. Do not pair a serif for the letter or a mono for the date.

rules.name: The Tight Title Rule
rules.body: Headlines and the masthead use semibold and tight tracking. Body and letter stay regular with open leading. Do not bold the letter paragraphs.

rules.name: The Same Sheet Rule
rules.body: / and /fortune share one clipboard frame. Change width and contents; do not invent a second surface.

rules.name: The One Plane Rule
rules.body: One sheet, one clip, one desk. Do not stack additional elevated cards on the paper.

rules.name: The Sharp Sheet Rule
rules.body: Paper and stamp stay square. Radius is hardware, not UI.

rules.name: The Underline Field Rule
rules.body: Inputs are transparent with a bottom ink rule. No filled wells, no 1px boxes.

dos: Do keep form and letter on the same clipboard sheet; switch only width (28rem / 40rem).
Do put the coral stamp under the underline fields, full width, 52px tall.
Do set copy in Korean, in Pretendard, with navy ink on cool gray paper.
Do divide the advice line with a hairline, not a card or a chip.
Do show loading as letter-shaped skeleton bars on the sheet.
donts: Don't introduce a night-sky, cream, or serif world — no gold stars, purple glow, or zodiac wheel.
Don't box the inputs or round the sheet and stamp.
Don't use coral on headlines, masthead, or letter body.
Don't add a marketing landing in front of the form, or a second elevated card on the paper.
Don't show star signs, share chrome, or login on these surfaces.
